notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Composite Golem.
description:
Cast Chapel Shieldgeist from your graveyard by paying it's disturb cost of {3}{W}.
Chapel Shieldgeist enters the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate Chapel Shieldgeist by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
